import struct,zlib
def ch(t,d): return struct.pack('>I',len(d))+t+d+struct.pack('>I',zlib.crc32(t+d))
raw=b''.join(b'\x00'+b'\xff\x00\x00'*8 for _ in range(8))
open('in.png','wb').write(b'\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n'+ch(b'IHDR',struct.pack('>IIBBBBB',8,8,8,2,0,0,0))+ch(b'IDAT',zlib.compress(raw))+ch(b'IEND',b''))
